headlines.title: Trump’s FDA pick sidesteps questions on abortion pill and vaccines at confirmation hearing
headlines.description: Dr. Heidi Overton, a fierce opponent of abortion rights, declined to say whether she believes the abortion pill mifepristone is safe.

headlines.title: She Started an Allergy-Friendly Snack Brand So Her Daughter Wouldn’t Feel Left Out. Now, the Girl Scouts Are Selling Her Cookies
headlines.description: Denise Woodard started allergy-friendly cookie company, Partake, so her daughter wouldn’t feel left out. Now, she’s selling her cookies with the Girl Scouts.

headlines.title: How to Prepare to Fall Sports and Avoid Getting Sidelined by Injury
headlines.description: Fall sports are in full swing, so Dr. Melissa Leber, associate professor of orthopedics and emergency medicine at Mount Sinai, joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY with tips to for preventing injuries, including the benefits of cross-training, making sure shoes from prior seasons still fit properly, when to seek medical attention and more.

headlines.title: Doctors in Pennsylvania estimate at least six babies have been born with measles
headlines.description: At least six babies in Pennsylvania have been born infected with measles, with two so sick they had to be admitted to intensive care. The growing outbreak is raising alarm among doctors who are treating the potentially deadly condition. Congenital measles is a disease that’s rarely, if ever, seen in the U.S. NBC News' Erika Edwards reports.

headlines.title: Ashley Park on Blood Donation Initiative, Wrapping 'Emily in Paris'
headlines.description: Actor Ashley Park joins TODAY’s Sheinelle Jones and guest co-host Justin Sylvester to talk about wrapping the final season of the Netflix hit series “Emily in Paris,” her close friendship with Lily Collins, attending Céline Dion’s comeback performance in Paris, and how her childhood battle with leukemia led her to work with Abbott to address the national blood shortage.

headlines.title: MLB's CC Sabathia Shares Health Message, Talks Hall of Fame
headlines.description: MLB star CC Sabathia joins TODAY to share a message about the importance of understanding your cholesterol numbers and shares his own health scare. “I was pitching in the big leagues and had no idea I had this blockage and just got lucky enough to be able to catch it,” he says. He also opens up about being inducted into the Monument Park Hall of Fame at Yankee Stadium. “It means more than going into the Hall of Fame…To be able to come to the Bronx, put on the pinstripes and succeed here�

headlines.title: 6 towel warmers that will make your shower experience feel luxurious
headlines.description: Make your post-shower experience feel more luxurious by heating your towel in a towel warmer — experts share what to look for when shopping.

headlines.title: Winter is coming — these on-sale finds will help you store your outdoor furniture
headlines.description: Summer’s over. Protect your patio furniture and grill this winter with deals on deck boxes, storage sheds and weatherproof covers from Keter, Duck Covers and more.

headlines.title: Love to Dream just recalled this popular sound machine
headlines.description: Love to Dream recalled its portable baby sound machine over a battery fire and burn risk. Here’s how to check your model and date code and get a refund.

headlines.title: Sale alert: Get a new pair of Ugg shoes for well under $100
headlines.description: Ugg rarely discounts, but several of its cozy slippers and shoes are now under $100. Shop the best Ugg deals before colder weather arrives.

headlines.title: I Tried Jennifer Aniston’s 30-Minute Strength Training Workout. These Are the Moves That Had My Heart Pounding
headlines.description: “Is this move more of a squat or a deadlift?” The answer, Jennifer Aniston’s trainer Dani Coleman tells me, was really neither.

headlines.title: Over 160,000 Pounds of Meat Recalled Due to Lack of Inspection, Receives Highest Risk Level From USDA
headlines.description: Approximately 167,639 pounds of raw pork, beef and goat products have been recalled for being produced without inspection. They were also falsely labeled.
